rules.statement: A letter acknowledging a debt and promising to pay within a specific time period constitutes a written promise under Section 6 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view Section 12 contemplates merely an acknowledgment of the debt. In the letter P3 there is not only an acknowledgment that the amount is due but also a clear promise to pay this amount within a month. I would, therefore, construe this letter as a written promise to pay the amount: accordingly, Section 6 and not Section 8 of the Prescription Ordinance applies to the facts of this case."

meta.parties: Adamjee Lukmanjee & Sons Ltd. v. Abdul Careem Hallaje
